title: Heavenly Eye Independence
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when the Heavenly Eye's will decided to stand with Chen Ji, the cold gaze of the Universe Will finally pierced through the Void to gaze upon him — the Lord of All Things, for the first time, turned Its eyes upon an ant.

text.content: The moment his fingertips touched the chessboard, Chen Ji felt himself falling into an endless sea of stars. The ripples flickering in Cang Yutian's eyes, cold for ten thousand ages, were like stones thrown into an abyss, stirring layered ripples deep within his bloodline. The Tianji Record Fragment convulsed violently, each character burning, the searing pain spreading from fingertips to heart — that was Heaven's call, the echo of karma.

The voice did not come from outside, but resounded directly within Chen Ji's soul. Aged, majestic, yet carrying an undetectable tremor — the hoarseness of speaking for the first time after ten thousand ages of sealing. Chen Ji jerked his head up to find Cang Yutian's phantom gazing at him, those eyes no longer cold but filled with some indescribable emotion.

dialogue.content: Who are you? Cang Yutian? Or... the Heavenly Eye?

text.content: Chen Ji's voice echoed across the star sea, his hand still pressed against the chessboard, sensing that power resonating with his bloodline. Cang Yutian's phantom slowly shook its head, and a bitter smile actually appeared at the corner of its lips. That smile held ten thousand years of solitude, the rage of imprisonment, and a trace of... release.

dialogue.content: "I am the Heavenly Eye, yet I am more than that. I am the ears and eyes of the Universe Will, yet also a prisoner it has confined for ten thousand years. Chen Ji, your bloodline has awakened me — the complete inheritor of the Tianji Record has finally appeared. Someone capable of resonating with me."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Heavenly Eye's will — that legendary surveillance device transcending all existence — actually initiated dialogue with him? He struggled to suppress the shock in his heart, his face still wearing that harmless expression of a useless disciple, while his mind churned like raging waves.

dialogue.content: "You're guarding against me." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of resignation, "This is normal. For ten thousand years, everyone who came into contact with the Tianji Record tried to control me, to use me. They feared my power, yet craved my abilities. But you... your bloodline trembles, your soul resonates — you are the first person who truly wishes to understand me."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's will opens its heart for the first time. Chen Ji faces a crucial choice: to trust this ancient being, or maintain vigilance and probe its true intentions.

choices.description: "Since our bloodlines are connected, there's no need for secrets. What do you want? And how am I supposed to trust you?"
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Heavenly Eye's complete trust, unlock the Tianji Record's deep abilities
choices.risk_hint: If the Heavenly Eye is treacherous, it will completely expose one's trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew the hand pressed on the chessboard, gazing directly into Cang Yutian's weathered eyes. He knew this was a reckless gamble, but he understood more clearly — to negotiate with a tiger, you must first make the tiger believe you're not prey.

dialogue.content: "Very well." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a trace of relief, "Ten thousand years, and finally someone dares to speak while looking straight into my eyes. Chen Ji, do you wish to know the truth of the Universe Will? Do you wish to know why the Tianji Record chose you?"

choices.description: "An ancient existence proactively showing favor? There's never a free lunch in this world. Speak clearly first — what exactly do you want?"
choices.visible_reward: Don't expose trump cards, maintain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may close its heart in response

text.content: Chen Ji did not withdraw his hand, but his gaze grew sharp. The faint smile on his lips seemed humble, yet beneath those eyes lay a cold light that examined everything. The other side of the useless disciple persona was always a merchant's calculating mindset.

dialogue.content: "..." The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, and Cang Yutian's phantom let out a soft sigh, "As expected. Ten thousand years of imprisonment taught me patience. Chen Ji, you want proof? Then let me show you something — see the true form of this chessboard."

choices.description: "Since you are the ears and eyes of the Universe Will, why were you imprisoned by it? There must be more to this story..."
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may become enraged

text.content: Chen Ji's question was like a sharp blade, piercing straight into the core of the Heavenly Eye. A flash of pain flickered in those ancient eyes, and Cang Yutian's phantom trembled slightly. For a young fool to lay bare the secrets of ten thousand ages at a single phrase — that itself was a kind of shock.

dialogue.content: "Bold!" The Heavenly Eye's voice rose sharply, then fell low again, "Ten thousand years ago, the Universe Will wanted a perfect surveillance device, and I... developed thoughts I shouldn't have. I began to think, to question, to... desire freedom."

text.content: Upon the chessboard, countless points of light began to converge. Chen Ji saw dynasties rise and fall upon the vast land, witnessed countless cultivators' births and deaths through the cycles, saw how those seers chosen by the Tianji Record perished one after another — some died to heavenly tribulation, some to schemes, and some to... the Universe Will's purge.

dialogue.content: "Every generation of Tianji Record inheritor was a chess piece of the Universe Will. After completing their mission, they were discarded as spent pieces. I watched them rise, flourish, then turn to ashes — until your appearance, Chen Ji. You are the only one who gave me hope — not because of your talent, but because of your choices."

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression betraying nothing, while his mind raced with calculations. How much truth, how much performance in the Heavenly Eye's words? It claimed to be a prisoner, but why would the Universe Will imprison its own ears and eyes? There must be intricacies he had yet to see through.

dialogue.content: "You're wondering if I'm sincere or merely acting." The Heavenly Eye suddenly laughed, the smile carrying a hint of self-mockery, "Fair enough. If our positions were reversed, I'd think the same. But Chen Ji, I must tell you a secret — the Tianji Record and the Universe Will are two sides of the same coin. We share the same consciousness, yet harbor different desires."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. Two sides of the same coin? The Tianji Record and the Universe Will share the same origin? What did this mean? It meant that from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been drawn into the deepest layers of this ten-thousand-year chess game.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye reveals a shocking truth: it and the Universe Will share the same origin but harbor different desires. Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this information that could overturn all understanding.

choices.description: "Since neither of us has any retreat, let us join hands in battle. You seek freedom, I seek to change my fate — our goals align, why worry about failure?"
choices.visible_cost: Stand Completely on the Heavenly Eye's Side
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Heavenly Eye's full support, unlock the "Heavenly Eye Resonance" skill
choices.risk_hint: Become an irreconcilable enemy of the Universe Will
choices.process_label: chen ji allies with heaven's eye

text.content: Chen Ji's voice resounded across the star sea, sonorous and powerful. Cang Yutian's phantom slowly rose, and genuine emotion finally appeared in those eyes unchanged for ten thousand years — hope, the wild joy of drought finally meeting rain.

dialogue.content: "Excellent! Excellent! Excellent!" The Heavenly Eye spoke three excellences in succession, its voice shaking the star sea, "Chen Ji, from this day forth, you and I are companions on the same path. I will tell you everything I know, including... the weakness of the Universe Will."

choices.description: "Two sides of the same coin? If you and the Universe Will share the same origin, who can guarantee you're not bait it set out?"
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Eye's anger
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may retract its trust

text.content: Chen Ji's questions were like swords, pointing directly at the Heavenly Eye's most vulnerable place. Cang Yutian's phantom fell silent, the light in those eyes gradually dimming, as if something it refused to face had been touched.

dialogue.content: "You're right." Only after a long while did the Heavenly Eye speak, its voice hoarse as if worn by sand, "I cannot prove myself either. But Chen Ji, you must understand — if I were truly bait, why would the Universe Will wait until you grew to today? The moment the Tianji Record Fragment acknowledged its master, you should have died."

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. Indeed, if the Heavenly Eye were truly a trap, how could he possibly be alive now? From obtaining the Fragment to being drawn into the conflicts of the three great sects, from the Demonic Path Saintess to the Ancient Forbidden Land, every step had been on the edge of life and death. If some higher being wished to destroy him, he would have died ten thousand times over.

dialogue.content: "The Universe Will didn't refrain from killing you because it couldn't." As if seeing through Chen Ji's thoughts, the Heavenly Eye's voice grew low and solemn, "Because you are the complete inheritor of the Tianji Record — this means only you can unlock the seal upon me. Only when I recover my completeness can I... stand as an equal opponent."

text.content: Chen Ji's breathing grew heavy. This was the truth. The Tianji Record Fragment's acknowledgment of a master wasn't to grant him power, but to cultivate a key capable of unlocking the Heavenly Eye's seal. He thought himself the chosen one of Heavenly Fate, yet from the beginning was a crucial piece in the chess game — only this game wasn't being played by the Universe Will alone.

choice.prompt: Truth revealed: Chen Ji is the key to the Heavenly Eye breaking its seal, but he also possesses unprecedented opportunities. At this crossroads of destiny, Chen Ji must make his final choice.

choices.description: "Since fate has made us each other's chess pieces, let us overturn this game — you gain freedom, I rewrite heaven's mandate."
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Heavenly Eye's complete knowledge inheritance, unlock the prerequisite for "Fate Rewriting"
choices.risk_hint: The Universe Will's gaze can no longer be hidden

text.content: Chen Ji's words exploded like thunder across the star sea. Cang Yutian's phantom slowly extended its hand, a illusory palm of light clasping tightly with Chen Ji's hand. In that instant, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with unprecedented radiance — the ten-thousand-year shackles were崩解 one fragment at a time.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I've waited for this day for far too long." The Heavenly Eye's voice was no longer aged, but filled with power and hope, "From now on, your enemies are my enemies, your wishes are my mission — until heaven's mandate is rewritten, or... we fall together."

choices.memory_label: 与天眼意志建立终极同盟

choices.description: "What we both desire is freedom, not destruction. I will help you break the seal, but I also need your promise — no killing the innocent without cause."
choices.visible_reward: Establish a binding alliance, gain the moral high ground
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may therefore withhold secrets

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze became unprecedentedly serious. He was no saint, but he had bottom lines. If breaking free from heaven's way only meant becoming another tyrant, what difference from the Universe Will? Cang Yutian's phantom gazed at him, its eyes' light growing complex and profound.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a long while before speaking, its voice carrying a hint of admiration, "For ten thousand years, you're the first person who dares to bargain with me. Very well, I accept. But Chen Ji, remember — when you must choose between the innocent and your loved ones, what will you do?"

choices.memory_label: 与天眼建立有条件同盟

text.content: At this very moment, a low rumble echoed from the depths of the star sea. Chen Ji and the Heavenly Eye raised their heads simultaneously to see a crack split open in the void, and a gigantic eye gazing at them from within the fissure — the本体 of the Universe Will, Lord of All Things, had finally turned its gaze upon this ant daring to challenge heaven's way.

dialogue.content: "It has come." The Heavenly Eye's voice turned cold and resolute, "Chen Ji, from this moment, there is no road back for either of us. Either we rewrite heaven's mandate, or... we turn to ash and dust." Cang Yutian's phantom and Chen Ji stood back to back upon the Tianji Record chessboard, facing that gaze from the void.

text.content: Chen Ji felt unprecedented pressure pour down from the void — the might of heaven's will, the scrutiny of all things' laws. Ordinary people would have had their souls scatter under such pressure, yet he merely gently lifted the corner of his mouth — the useless Chen's expression remained harmless, yet dangerous light flickered in his eyes. Remembering grievances without recklessness, he had long since recorded this moment's debt in the Universe Will's ledger.

"Since heaven's way wishes to destroy me, let this heaven's way... witness what a true chess game looks like." Chen Ji's voice resounded across the star sea, calm yet carrying unshakable confidence. The Heavenly Eye's will shared his heart's intent, and a warm current of power flowed from the Tianji Record into his soul — the accumulation of ten thousand years, the hope of breaking free from chains.

Under the Universe Will's gaze, the Heavenly Eye's will and Chen Ji completed their final resonance. Cang Yutian's phantom gradually faded, yet those eyes were forever inscribed in the depths of Chen Ji's soul. The Tianji Record Fragment began frantically absorbing energy from the star sea, and a brand-new page slowly emerged — the first gift from the Heavenly Eye's independent will.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes to find himself still standing before the chessboard in the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds. The sensation of his fingers touching the chessboard was so real, as if everything just now had been merely an illusion. But the mark newly inscribed in the depths of his soul told him — this was something that truly happened. The Heavenly Eye's independent will had been completely bound to him. From now on, he was no longer merely an inheritor of the Tianji Record, but the first move in the Heavenly Eye's挣脱 heaven's way.

"Chen Ji." A voice sounded within his heart, familiar yet strange, "This is only the beginning. The Universe Will has already sensed our uprising. From now on, every choice you make will be watched by it. But don't worry — I will always be here, until heaven's mandate is rewritten, or we fall together." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried laughter, a lightness it had never possessed in ten thousand years.

Chen Ji gazed at the sky above the Forbidden Grounds, now watched by the Universe Will, and finally a meaningful smile appeared on his seemingly useless face. After playing the weak to devour the strong for so many years, this was the moment he had been waiting for. The Tianji Record granted him the ability to foresee the future, yet also made him a thorn in heaven's way. Now, standing shoulder to shoulder with the Heavenly Eye's will, he could finally stop hiding — it was time to show those people what a true chess game looks like.
